notes.title: Void Bastards 1.2.2 Now Available on Pre-Release Beta
notes.notes:
Void Bastards patch 1.2.2 is now available on the pre-release Beta. If you want to try out the pre-release Beta, you can find instructions here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/857980/announcements/detail/2427918161437433843

Patch notes:

Fixes


 Steam achievements are now posted during gameplay rather than when exiting the game.
 Fixed Void whale encounter text (English).
 Fixed some walls in Security which enemies could see through.
 Fixed some rifts that were placed below the ground in the Dock.
 Fixed citizens not roaming into new rooms as much as they should.
 Fixed the fix to progress and locate parts being found on the same ship.
 Fixed jiggling on player proximity light in dark ships.


Improvements

 Don’t generate fixed tutorial vessels when replaying the campaign after completing it.
 Care packages will no longer grant parts that aren’t useful due to current campaign weapon restriction mode.
 Food and fuel in care packages will reflect Travel Subsidy and Travel Rort upgrades even when not starting a new client.
 Oily footstep cadence is faster.

notes.title: Pre-Release Test Beta Now Available
notes.notes:
Hi, we've created a new beta of the game which we will be using for the latest patches before they are released. If you would like to preview what's coming and help us test new builds, please consider switching to this beta using the following process:


 Navigate to your Steam library.
 Right click on Void Bastards and select Properties.
 Select the Betas tab.
 Enter the super secret beta access code: voidbastards.
 Push the check code button.
 Now select prerelease - latest prerelease test build from the drop down menu.
 When you return to the library, Steam should now automatically download the latest prerelease build (assuming you have the game set to automatically update).


Note that this prelease build is exactly that. It may contain bugs or other errors so you should not install this beta if you are concerned about potentially losing your progress or otherwise experiencing problems with the game. 

If you do wish to install this prerelease test beta you will greatly help us if you can report any issues with it in the forums or on our Discord. Please mark any such reports as "prerelease beta" so that we know which build of the game you are reporting on. You can also check the build version by opening the game console with Alt ~ and typing version.

Thanks for your help!
